correctness.rationale: For any positions i<j, canceling common prefix and suffix converts duplicate-output equality exactly into xz=zy with length-two blocks x,y. When j-i=1 direct letter equations force a,complement(a),a; when j-i>=2 the word equation forces a period-two intervening substring whose terminal two letters equal their reverse complement. The preceding pair is then fixed by reverse complement, giving the full alternating interval, and conversely any such interval yields equality. Resulting equivalence classes of insertion positions are intervals: their number is n-1 minus the number of alternating triples. The two-state weighted transition count is exact for all q and n; formal 2x2 matrix inversion yields the bivariate rational function. Exact Bernoulli indicator covariances produce both moments. The reproducibility code constructs real descendants, verifies all position-pair collisions, histograms, moments, and transfer recurrences at enumerated finite lengths. All quantifiers and n=2 boundary are explicit.

value.rationale: The exact distribution of one-step output branching in a fixed-length DNA-motivated reverse-complement duplication channel is a natural invariant directly connected to degeneracy of error locations and counting/sphere-packing considerations. A complete rational distribution uniformly across all source words, block lengths n>=2, and every even alphabet q>=2 is substantially more informative than checking one finite case or a simple average. The structural collision law gives a mechanism; mean, variance and sharp extremizers follow. No claim of a new optimal code or multi-error theorem is made.
